caption: The video captures a full-frame view of a turbulent fire, with a dark region on the left grading into a churning orange mass on the right and a yellow-white hotspot in the upper-right area. Dozens of tiny glowing embers are suspended across the frame, appearing as points and short streaks. The background flame is not static; the bright hotspot migrates upward and changes shape while the orange mass churns and deforms. Over the clip the dark zone on the left grows larger, yet the relative layout of dark-left and bright-right persists throughout. The spark streaks lengthen over the clip into mostly vertical lines, indicating a drift relative to the frame. No single ember can be followed from first to last frame, so the visible motion reads as a swirling flow of many sparks. The composition holds even as the flame texture shifts and the streaking intensifies. The fire and the embers are already in progress at the opening and continue to the final frame.
relations: If turbulent fire churns, bright hotspot migrates upward and deforms while orange mass remains right.
As left dark region expands, dark-left/bright-right layout persists and flame continuity is not erased.
Suspended embers drift relative to frame, streaks lengthening mostly vertical as many sparks swirl.
Individual embers need not remain trackable, but collective spark flow persists from opening to end.
